subject.title: fix(sessions): stop persisting media-only caption placeholder into transcripts

question: Does the session/transcript owner approve the upgrade contract in which newly persisted media-only turns use empty content while the model-facing marker is reconstructed at the LLM boundary?
rationale: The patch intentionally changes durable session transcript content, and the `maintainer` label requires explicit human handling even though the proposed boundary design is coherent.

options.title: Approve after live proof
options.body: Accept blank persisted content once a redacted real media-only upload and replay demonstrate no UI caption regression and unchanged provider-facing marker behavior.

options.title: Retain stored marker
options.body: Keep the existing persisted marker if maintainers decide transcript text itself must remain directly model-ready or user-visible to existing consumers.

recommendation.title: Approve after live proof
recommendation.body: Accept blank persisted content once a redacted real media-only upload and replay demonstrate no UI caption regression and unchanged provider-facing marker behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: This person authored the cross-path session-boundary change and is the best available routing candidate in the supplied history.
